name: layers-e2e-assigned-to-dropped-without-agent-node
body: The fixture's assigned-to edge names agent.go-frontend-implementer, but the scratch scan defines no Agent node, so ingest's dangling-edge filter drops that one edge; the StructCreate operation edge does land and joins the planned fixture.mod.Widget. Limit: the assignment edge is not observable in db.lbug for this fixture. Upgrade if the assignment itself must be observable in db.lbug: add an agent definition record to the fixture's scan payload.
